name: magenxcommerce/module-deal-graph-ql
description: Extends Magento Catalog Price Rules with a merchandising deal label + type (deal / first-order) and exposes them over GraphQL: a `deals` query, a per-product `deal` badge (label, type, authoritative deal price from the rule, schedule/countdown) for grids and the PDP, and a `deals_enabled` store-config flag. The Catalog Price Rule is the single source of truth for conditions, actions and pricing; this module only adds the presentation on top.
